purpose: Show hiking trails and mountain forest tracks; exclude facility/pocket-park walks.

selection_policy.include_when: Trail or mountain access track is supported by contextual evidence (terrain, official trail data, independent GPX/field inspection, and source tags), not only connected vertices.
selection_policy.exclude_when: Facility/campus/urban or pocket-park walking paths; building-area loops and pedestrian walkways without trail context.
selection_policy.ambiguous: Keep the original way in an audit queue; never auto-promote to map or route calculation.
selection_policy.note: v81 filtering is specific to the six v78 footways identified in this review. Other earlier OSM material is not yet fully field audited.
